The Twin-228 [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] was a model produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]]. On many worlds, such as [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], it was modified as a [[Speeder truck/Legends|speeder truck]] by the addition of a [[Cargo pod/Legends|cargo pod]].

The speed of the Twin-228 made it a popular speeder on more urban worlds while the optional cargo pod attachments made them a common sight on agricultural worlds as well.
